description: Department  of Trade and Investment policy -  Order under Special Commodity Levy Act, that the Levy on Cane or Beet sugar, Raw Suger etc., w.e.f. 16.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and amendment of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory details about tax rates on specific commodities (sugar products) and rescinds a previous order. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
